name: Driftkin — Cartographers of the Unwritten
tagline: Spectral founders who map lands no one has walked, and raise waygates where paths end.
drop_in: Copy this folder into your QI-Games instance as modules/driftkin/ and call register(CLASSES) from engine/founders.py.

class.title: Mapper of Unwritten Lands
class.creed: Beyond the known, more world awaits.
class.quirk: leaves footprints that fade by morning

Wayfinding.desc: chance to raise a waygate at path's end

Invention.desc: chance to invent a NEW structure kind

new_structures.desc: teleports founders across the map; anchors exploration.
echoes a founder's last discovery to nearby allies.
forges a crystal from mapped starlight; trade good.

lore: The Driftkin are not born — they are remembered into being by founders who wandered too far. Each carries a map of places that do not yet exist, and builds the structures that make them real.
